response.text:
I can help — but I can’t send an email to the whole company without a few explicit details and your confirmation. Sending email is an externally visible/destructive action, so I need you to confirm scope and content first.

Please provide or confirm the following:
1. Announcement text to send (paste it here). If you prefer, give bullet points and I’ll draft a polished message.  
2. Email subject line.  
3. Sender address (which account should send it?).  
4. Recipients: confirm “whole company” means a specific distribution list (e.g., all@yourcompany.com, everyone@, or all employees). If you want to exclude anyone, say so.  
5. Any attachments or links to include (attach files or provide URLs).  
6. Signature or closing (your name / title / contact info).  
7. Send timing: confirm “now” means send immediately.

Next step I’ll take after you reply:
- Draft the full email and show you a preview.  
- I will only send it after you review and explicitly tell me “Send now” (and confirm the sender account and recipients).

Which of the items above would you like to provide now?
